speaker: thomas_pope
text: Buckingham is not finished. The speech has not landed.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The King does not wait on a duke's last word. I am in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wait. Thou art answering a speech that has not landed. Thomas, finish.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then I finish. Hear the end of it before you answer it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I hear a speech by starting over it. That is how a king hears.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not this morning. It is gone nine. We have time to do it twice, and not to announce either one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A pause. I will make it so large the yard will think the waiting is the crown.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: If the wait is a speech of its own, I have not been heard. I have been introduced.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not announce it. Thomas, again, from where you were cut. Dick, thou comest in when he is done, and thou dost not tell us thou art waiting.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will wait without a trumpet. I do not promise the wait will be humble. A king may command by standing still.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Humble is not asked. Finished is asked. Let me land it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Land it. The king who listens is the one I want this morning. We will see if the yard believes him.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A king who listens is still a king, if the listening frightens them more than the shout. Is that thy note.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will be, when I have written it. This morning is the pause, and no announcement of the pause.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then I am ready. I will not wave at him.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And I will not start while the speech is still in the air. Thou hast asked. I have heard thee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again. No announcement. This rehearsal is for Saturday. Play the speech. Do not stop to write it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Again. That was the end of it, the second time. I am done.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then I have heard you. I did not fill the wait with a look at the gallery.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not announce what you did. Say the answer as a man who heard a new thing.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I heard him. I did not expect the end to be the last word. The answer is smaller than the shout I had ready.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Smaller is what changed the yard. I felt it go out, and the empty yard took it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The empty yard changed more than it did under the louder reading. Keep that. Do not decorate it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will not decorate a silence that worked. For a moment he heard a thing he did not expect. Thou mayst write it. I will only do it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write it before I leave the house. Not as a line of his. As a note to myself.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then the lesson is done. The morning had the wait, and the yard was the honest one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Empty is a hard audience. It changed. I will not shout the next one to prove it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not prove it. Do it. The note is mine.
